rules.rule: Signs alternate malefic/benefic, masculine/feminine, and movable/fixed/dual from Aries
Night signs (Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Sagittarius, Capricorn) rise feet-first; day signs head-first; Pisces by both
Moolatrikona signs (Sun:Leo, Moon:Taurus, Mars:Aries, Mercury:Virgo, Jupiter:Sagittarius, Venus:Libra, Saturn:Aquarius)

notes: Positional enumerations from Ch 1 (lords v6, Kalapurusha v4, day/night v10, gender/mobility/direction v11, moolatrikona v14, colours v20 — colours are OCR-damaged and flagged). Exaltation/debilitation degrees live in Ch 2.
